quests.title: Blackcliff Woes

dialogue.t: *sigh* Where did those monsters come from...
Is that so... *sigh* Then it seems like that work site can't be reopened.
I understand the situation. Please take this as thanks for your help.
But at this rate, our quotas are going to require some extensions.
Gah, I have to find some place where we can start work...

quests.description: Manager Kuan seems to be troubled by something…
